name: cannibal.r_caol_first_smoke_saved_brazier_continuation_v1
description: Task-owned continuation from the already saved v2 smoke-first TestSetup00 profile. Fixture installation and world replacement are intentionally omitted so the exact saved player position, canceled Tilda activity, closed-room geometry and cannibal camp are resumed without reseeding.

steps.label: resume_saved_closed_room_world
steps.expected_visible_fact: Resume the exact saved task-owned TestSetup00 world without fixture installation or world replacement.

steps.label: no_fixture_install_on_saved_world_continuation
steps.expected_visible_fact: Registry continuation launches with no fixture declared; saved profile/world is already present.

steps.label: observe_closed_room_brazier_smoke_first
steps.objective: Resume the exact saved player/world/camp state. Pick up the already supplied charged lighter if it remains on the floor; use its ordinary item action and choose the prepared brazier at Light where. Verify an actual burning brazier, step about two tiles away without entering fire, keep the closed-room fire supplied, and observe physical smoke/cannibal camp response over the next couple of in-game days with intermittent state checks.
proof_targets: same saved v2 profile/world and player position, with no fixture reinstall
brazier identity and position inside the closed room
charged lighter identity and native ignition choice
actual brazier fire state after input
two-tile observation position outside the fire
closed windows/curtains and fire maintenance state
physical smoke origin/channel reaching the task-added cannibal camp at OMT [135,137,0]
camp actor identity, admission, dispatch and progression or their first missing boundary
exact elapsed in-game time and intermittent native camp/movement observations
invariants: resume the existing saved task-owned world without fixture installation or replacement
the ordinary brazier fire is the only smoke-first source; no smokebomb credit
no authored or injected smoke, fire, light, signal, actor, dispatch, or contact
keep windows and curtains closed and maintain the fire through ordinary gameplay
do not step onto the brazier/fire when moving to the observation position
distinguish the player's basecamp at [131,143,0] from the cannibal camp at [135,137,0]
absence within a short observation window is inconclusive

evidence_contract.claim: A normal player-lit brazier fire in the closed room generates physical smoke that reaches the task-added cannibal camp and produces the native admission/materialization/dispatch/progression sequence before any valid light.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: The existing saved world is continuation footing only. Feature proof requires exact saved-world binding, actual native fire, closed-room state, source-identified physical smoke at the cannibal camp, ordered native response evidence and exact cleanup; otherwise report the first missing boundary as inconclusive.
